title: Seeing the Small: Deformable Duality Mamba for Retinal Lesion Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) lesions vary widely in shape, and microaneurysms (MAs) span only a few pixels. We hypothesize that modeling the spatial organization of lesion regions, with global context and shape-adaptive scanning, improves the segmentation of such small and irregular lesions. To test this, we propose D$^2$Mamba, which couples non-causal state space duality with deformable Mamba scanning. We evaluate it with five-fold cross-validation on the DDR dataset, comparing against representative segmentation baselines under an identical training protocol, and conduct ablations on each component. D$^2$Mamba achieved the best overall performance, with 33.87% mIoU, 2.99 percentage points above the strongest baseline. The largest gain appeared on MAs, the smallest and most easily missed lesions, where Dice improved by 10.06 percentage points. These results confirm our hypothesis that spatially adaptive state space modeling benefits tiny

translated_title: 看见微小：面向视网膜病变分割的可变形对偶Mamba
translated_abstract: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）病灶形状差异极大，而微动脉瘤（MA）仅占几个像素。我们假设，通过结合全局上下文与形状自适应扫描来对病灶区域的空间组织进行建模，能够改善这类微小且不规则病灶的分割。为验证该假设，我们提出了D²Mamba，它将非因果状态空间对偶性与可变形Mamba扫描相结合。我们在DDR数据集上采用五折交叉验证进行评估，在相同的训练协议下与代表性分割基线方法进行对比，并对各组件进行了消融实验。D²Mamba取得了最佳的整体性能，mIoU达到33.87%，比最强基线高出2.99个百分点。最大的增益出现在微动脉瘤上——这是最小、最容易被漏检的病灶，其Dice系数提升了10.06个百分点。这些结果证实了我们的假设，即空间自适应的状态空间建模有利于微小病灶的分割。
tldr: 提出D²Mamba，通过将非因果状态空间对偶性与可变形Mamba扫描相结合来建模病灶的空间组织，在DDR数据集上实现33.87%的mIoU，其中微动脉瘤分割Dice提升10.06个百分点。
en_tdlr: D²Mamba couples non-causal state space duality with deformable Mamba scanning to model the spatial organization of retinal lesions, achieving 33.87% mIoU on DDR with a 10.06 percentage point Dice gain on tiny microaneurysms.
